entities.summary: Nonka Decheva Matova is a Bulgarian police officer and rifle shooter who won silver at the 1992 Olympics, gold at the alternative to the 1984 Olympics, "Druzhba" tournament in Moscow, Russia and sixteen medals at World Championships.
